dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: How the marketplace is doing. Days are Dhaka calendar days, and changes compare with the previous period of the same length.
dashboard.comingBody: Live rides, match rate, revenue and contribution per ride will appear here once trips and payments exist.
dashboard.helpRides: Trips that finished in the period (counted on the day they completed). Requests are counted on the day they were made.
dashboard.helpMatchRate: Requests that found a driver ÷ all requests made in the period. A request counts as matched once a driver accepted it, even if the ride was cancelled later.
dashboard.helpMatchTime: Median time from request to a driver accepting it. P90 is the time 9 in 10 passengers waited less than. Medians are used because a few long waits would distort an average.
dashboard.helpGross: Total fares of completed rides before any discount (what the rides were worth).
dashboard.helpRevenue: Commission plus booking fees on completed rides. Discounts are not deducted here; see contribution.
dashboard.helpContribution: (Commission + booking fees − platform-funded discounts) ÷ completed rides. Shown separately for rides with and without a promotion so subsidised rides do not hide the real margin.
dashboard.helpFunnel: Of the requests made in the period: how many were matched, started and completed. The percentage is the drop from the previous step.
dashboard.helpCancellations: Requests that ended without a completed ride, by who or what ended them.
dashboard.nothingLost: Every request in this period completed.
dashboard.helpIntraday: Requests and matches in 15-minute slots (Dhaka time). Uses the live rollup, so it ignores the date range.
dashboard.intradayAria: Requests and matches in 15-minute slots over the last 12 hours
dashboard.noRecentRequests: No requests in the last 12 hours.
dashboard.onlineNow: {count, plural, one {# driver online now} other {# drivers online now}}
dashboard.attn_cash_mismatches: Cash collected differs from the fare
dashboard.helpZoneHealth: Match rate per zone for the period. Green is 85% or more, amber 70 to 85%, red below 70%. Zones with fewer than 5 requests are not judged.
dashboard.supply: Drivers online over the last 12 hours
dashboard.helpSupply: Average number of drivers online and idle, and on a trip, in each 15-minute slot (Dhaka time), from the availability history. Compare with the requests chart to spot supply gaps.
dashboard.noSupply: No driver activity recorded in the last 12 hours.
dashboard.supplyAria: Average drivers online and on a trip per 15-minute slot over the last 12 hours
dashboard.helpSurge: Zones where fares are above normal. The multiplier is the higher of the zone's manual surge and the automatic one, which rises when open requests per idle driver exceed the target and falls back a step each minute.
dashboard.noSurge: No zone has surge pricing right now.

ledger.adjustRequested: Adjustment requested. It now needs approval.
ledger.reversalBody: Posts an exact mirror of this transaction, so the books return to where they were. The original stays on record. A different admin must approve it.
ledger.reversalRequested: Reversal requested. It now needs approval.

payouts.emptyAccounts: No payout accounts are waiting for review.
payouts.rejectedNote: Account details could not be verified.
payouts.makerChecker: Created by {name}. A different admin has to approve it.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.subtitle: Discount codes with budgets that can't be overspent.
promotions.editorBody: The platform funds the discount; drivers are paid on the full fare. Code and discount are locked once someone has redeemed it.
promotions.budgetHelp: The budget is reserved when a passenger applies the code, so it can never be overspent. Unused reservations are released.
promotions.allWhenEmpty: Leave all unchecked to allow every area.
promotions.budgetExplain: Reserved when a passenger applies the code, settled to the real discount when the trip completes, released if the ride doesn't happen.
promotions.roiContributionHint: Commission and fees minus the discount
promotions.body_activate: Passengers can start using the code immediately (inside its dates).
promotions.body_pause: New redemptions stop. Rides already using it are not affected.
promotions.body_end: This is permanent. The code stops working and cannot be restarted.

support.replyPlaceholder: Write a reply. The person who opened the ticket will see it.
support.notePlaceholder: Write an internal note. Only admins can see it.

ratings.hideBody: It no longer counts toward the average or shows to anyone. It stays on record.

safety.title: Safety
safety.subtitle: SOS alerts and incident reports. Every step needs a note.
safety.polling: Checking for new incidents every 5 seconds.
safety.unackedBody: Someone should respond now. The clock runs until the first acknowledgement.
safety.locationLogged: Viewing this location is recorded in the access log.
safety.body_acknowledged: Tell the team someone is on it. This stops the response clock.
safety.body_investigating: Record what you are doing now.
safety.body_escalated: Hand it to someone with more authority and say who.
safety.body_resolved: Describe the outcome. It can still be reopened.
safety.body_closed: The incident is finished. Nothing more will be added.
safety.evidenceHelp: Photos, PDF, audio or video up to 15 MB. The file is checked and stored privately.
safety.evidenceLogged: Every time a file is opened it is written to the access log.
safety.evidenceFailed: The file could not be added.
safety.evidenceType: Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, MP4 or M4A file.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Definitions are one click away on every figure, so every team calculates them the same way.
analytics.def_completionRate: Requests that ended in a completed ride ÷ requests made.
analytics.def_noDriverRate: Requests that expired with no driver found ÷ requests made. High values mean a supply gap.
analytics.def_matchTime: Median seconds from request to a driver accepting. Medians resist a few extreme waits.
analytics.def_gross: Fares of completed rides before discounts.
analytics.def_discounts: Promotion discounts funded by the platform on completed rides.
analytics.def_avgFare: Mean fare before discount. The median is shown beneath because a few long rides lift the mean.
analytics.def_avgDistance: Mean actual distance of completed rides, from the GPS trail (or the routed estimate when the trail was too thin).
analytics.def_avgDuration: Mean time from start to completion.
analytics.def_driverEarnings: What drivers earned on completed rides after commission.
analytics.def_dailyMoney: Platform revenue next to the discounts it paid for, per day.
analytics.dailyMoneyAria: Platform revenue and discounts for each day in the range
analytics.subsidy: Rides with and without a promotion
analytics.def_subsidy: Splits completed rides by whether a promotion discount was applied, so subsidised rides cannot hide the real margin.
analytics.subsidyNote: Contribution on subsidised rides is revenue minus the discount the platform paid.
analytics.def_activeDrivers: Drivers who completed at least one ride in the period.
analytics.def_newDrivers: Drivers whose application was approved in the period.
analytics.def_driverCancels: Requests cancelled by the driver after accepting.
analytics.def_driverTable: Drivers with trips accepted in the period. Acceptance is accepted offers ÷ offers received.
analytics.def_repeatRiders: Passengers with two or more completed rides in the period ÷ passengers who rode.
analytics.def_ticketsPer100: Support tickets opened by passengers ÷ completed rides × 100.
analytics.def_avgRating: Mean passenger rating of drivers in the period (hidden ratings excluded).
analytics.def_waitDistribution: Matched requests grouped by time from request to a driver accepting.
analytics.def_refunds: Refunds approved and posted in the period.
analytics.def_cashOwed: Cash collected on the platform's behalf and not yet deposited, across all drivers right now.
analytics.def_payoutFailure: Payouts marked failed ÷ payouts created in the period. The target is 2% or less.
analytics.def_flaggedFares: Completed rides whose fare was far above the estimate, or whose distance came from the fallback.
analytics.def_paymentHealth: Payments created in the period that are still unconfirmed, unreconciled, or collected for a different amount.
analytics.def_ledgerHealth: Result of the latest nightly check that every balance matches its entries.

exports.title: Exports
exports.subtitle: Download data as CSV. Exports contain no phone numbers, emails or document details, and every download is logged.
exports.privacy: Files are kept for 7 days, then deleted. Only you can download your exports.
exports.noKinds: Your permissions do not cover any exportable data.
exports.queued: Export queued. It will appear here when it is ready.
exports.emptyBody: Create one above. Small exports are ready immediately.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Business-health checks that run every minute. Each alert fires once while it lasts and clears by itself.
alerts.emptyOpenBody: Match rates, supply, safety, money and the dispatch loop are all within their targets.
alerts.ackBody: Tell the team you are on it. The alert stays open until the condition clears.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Operational tuning and feature flags. Every change is validated, versioned and written to the audit log with your reason.
settings.editBody: {key} takes effect immediately for new activity. Your reason is saved in the audit log.
settings.historyFailed: The history could not be loaded.
settings.noHistory: This setting has not been changed.
settings.flagBody: Switch the feature on or off, or limit it to a share of users or to certain zones.
settings.percentageHelp: Leave empty for everyone. A percentage always gives the same user the same answer.
settings.zonesHelp: Leave all unchecked for every zone.
settings.archiveNoAccess: The archive log needs the audit permission.
settings.archiveEmptyBody: Partitions older than their retention period are verified, recorded here and moved out of the live tables. Nothing is ever purged.
settings.deliveryHelp: Messages are queued by the system (for example when an SOS is raised) and sent by a worker, with automatic retries. Counts cover the last 7 days.

privacy.title: Privacy requests
privacy.subtitle: People who asked to delete their account. They are deactivated at once; their personal details are anonymised after the grace period. Money, safety and audit records are kept.
privacy.restoreBody: They can sign in again and nothing is anonymised. Use this only inside the grace period, for example when the request was a mistake.

views.currentHas: The current filters can be saved with the + button.
views.currentEmpty: Apply some filters, then save them with the + button.
views.saveBody: Saves the filters and search you have applied so you can come back to them in one click.
views.name: Name

crud.addVehicleBody: Registers a vehicle for this driver. It still needs verification before it can take rides.
crud.assignDriverBody: Creates the trip now with the driver you choose. They must be online, approved and free, with an active vehicle of the requested type. Other pending offers are withdrawn.
crud.assigned: Driver assigned. The trip has started.
crud.bookRideBody: Books a ride for a passenger, for example a phone booking. The fare is quoted from the live fare rule exactly as in the app, and the request goes through normal dispatch. Cash only.
crud.booked: Ride booked. Dispatch is looking for a driver.
crud.cancelMatchedBody: A driver has accepted this ride. Cancelling it cancels the trip and frees the driver. The passenger is not charged a cancellation fee.
crud.cancelRequestBody: Stops the search and closes the request as cancelled by admin. The history is kept.
crud.confirmCashBody: Records that the driver collected this fare in cash (when they could not confirm it in the app). The amount goes to the driver's cash dues, like an in-app confirmation.
crud.coordHint: Tip: paste "23.7806, 90.4074" from any map into the latitude box to fill both.
crud.deleteAccountBody: The account is deactivated now: the person is signed out and cannot sign in. It can be restored from Privacy for the next 30 days, then their personal details are removed. Rides, payments and safety records are kept. Not possible during a ride or while money is owed.
crud.deleted: Account deleted. It can be restored from Privacy during the grace period.
crud.editContactBody: Changes the name shown to drivers and passengers, and the phone used for messages. The email is the sign-in and is not changed here.
crud.editDatesBody: Corrects the issue and expiry dates of this document. Expiry reminders and suspensions follow the new dates.
crud.editNoteBody: Changes the note the driver sees for the pickup. Only while the request is still looking for a driver.
crud.editRefundBody: Changes the amount and reason of your request while it waits for approval. Approvers see the new values.
crud.editVehicleBody: Corrects the vehicle's details. The vehicle type cannot change while the driver is online with it.
crud.fileHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB. The real file type is checked.
crud.newAlertBody: Raises an alert for the team, for example a road closure or an outage at a partner. It stays open until someone resolves it.
crud.newDriverBody: Creates a driver account. The driver then completes onboarding (or you add their vehicle and documents here) and is approved as usual.
crud.newPassengerBody: Creates a passenger account that can sign in to the app right away.
crud.newPhoneHint: Leave empty to keep the current number.
crud.passwordHint: Leave empty and the person sets their own with "Forgot password".
crud.resolveAlertBody: Closes the alert. An automatic alert opens again if its condition still holds.
crud.retireVehicleBody: Takes the vehicle out of service. Its trips and documents are kept. Not possible while the driver is online with it.
crud.searchPeople: Search by name, email or phone
crud.uploadDocumentBody: Uploads a document for this driver, for example one they brought to the office. It goes to the review queue like any other upload.
crud.uploaded: Document uploaded and queued for review
crud.withdrawDocumentBody: The document no longer counts for the driver (they may need to upload a new one). The file and its review history are kept.
crud.viewDocumentBody: Opened from a link that expires in 60 seconds. Every view is recorded.
crud.chooseVehicle: Choose the vehicle this document belongs to.
crud.fileWrongType: Upload a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF file.
crud.fileTooBig: The file must be 10 MB or smaller.
